entries.en: Now that I'm getting a second look here,[n]I've noticed just how mysterious this[n]place is...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: What could this building even be?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It depends on what the Palace's Ruler[n]thinks of the place.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We'll likely find that out if we keep[n]pushing forward.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Well... I'm not sure how to put it...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh, you mean this old thing?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Yoshizawa-san aside, there's no reason[n]for me to uphold the pretense of a[n]righteous, sincere Detective Prince.
